title: Heat model: carry fire-cooldown remainder so cadence does not drift at 72 Hz
acceptance: StepHeat keeps the leftover time when the fire cooldown expires (FireCooldown += 1/FireRate instead of = 1/FireRate)
ETM.Weapons.HeatParity.Quest72Hz passes with one-frame time tolerance and 1% dps tolerance
balance_sim.py updated the same way if its numbers move, and the bible's P-01 figures re-checked
description: Found by T-0010. At 72 Hz with 1/240 s sub-steps the model resets the fire cooldown on the sub-step where it expires, so each shot slips up to 3.5 ms. Measured: overheat at 2.792 s instead of 2.751 s (12 shots either way), burst+vent 89.33 dps instead of 90.67. The 72 Hz parity test currently allows 3 frames and 2% to stay green; tighten it when this is fixed.

result.summary: Fix shipped inside T-0055: StepHeat carries the fire-cooldown remainder; 72 Hz parity test tightened to one frame and 1%.
result.verification: ETM.Weapons.HeatParity.Quest72Hz passes at the tightened tolerance; owner headset test
